summary: REQUEST_CHANGES。F2 连续 G0→G1→G2 的 older-generation gate、无 successor prompt reclaim，以及 F3 统一 live-entity 公式和 pre-cap purge 均已静态验证闭合；C5/C7 也已正确传 advertisement origin。但 _peer_bit_value 在当前 topo[origin] 已删除该方向、peer=None 时跳过 peer 校验并接受旧 queue value，导致有效 TTL 内的 stale advertisement fail-open。现有 fresh/mismatched-peer 回归未覆盖 removed-direction 情形。

findings.summary: FACT: peer-bound queue metric 在 rematch 删除整个方向时 fail-open；peer=None 会绕过 identity mismatch 检查，使 C5/C7 接受已不存在链路的旧 isl_queue_bits。

FACT: one-transceiver gate applies to retired and current successors alike, waits only for older same-slot generations, avoiding G0/G1 deadlock; drain path promptly purges retired generations. Continuous-rematch regression checks active-service exclusivity after every event step.

FACT: max_entities uses one live-entity formula shared by lazy endpoint creation and topology recompute; drained retired generations are purged before planned-new cap accounting. Cross-term tests cover both creation orders and no-successor reclaim.

INFERENCE: static paths preserve receipt transition accounting, holding capacity/FIFO accounting, and stop-time accounting for reclaimed ISL generations; runtime test execution was not permitted by this remote read-only review.
